text.p: Fator Securities said it has upgraded its recommendation on Brazilian paints and coating conglomerate Renner Herrmann to buy from hold.

-- "We are upgrading our recommendation on Renner Herrmann to buy from hold as recently published first quarter results demonstrate that its operating overhaul is bearing fruit," Fator analyst Juan Tseng said in a report.

-- Tseng also said Renner Herrmann has an upside potential of 60 percent over the next 12 months, adding the stock is undervalued by 40 percent relative to the international sector based on 1996 EBITDA.
-- Its restructuring and key alliances for multinationals will enable it to leverage its operating turaround through this year, he added.
-- The firm, which targets primarily the automotive and decorative industries, is the leader in Brazil in most of its markets and also operates in other South American countries, Tseng said.
-- "It has technological alliances with multinationals DuPont, Valspar, Kansai, Cenacchi and Hickson," he wrote.
-- Worries about liquidity should ease "as the company gains investors awareness with improving results and the establishment of strategic partnerships with major global players," he wrote.
-- Renner Herrmann's preferred was up 3.2 percent at 1.29 reais at 1615 local/1515 gmt on the Sao Paulo bourse.
